title: Sahebs Who Never Left
desc: Poster, social artwork and trailer work for a Prachyam documentary.
lead: I worked on the poster, social artwork and trailer for Prachyam’s Sahebs Who Never Left.
body: Sahebs Who Never Left presents Prachyam’s argument about colonial influence and Indian history. My work here covers the film’s poster, social campaign and trailer.
detail: I used historical portraits, layered collage and bold typography across the campaign, with red, black and paper textures tying the pieces together.
contribution: Creative direction and visual design for the selected campaign work.
Composition, typography and motion treatment across the poster, social artwork and trailer.
summary: I worked on the poster, social artwork and trailer for Prachyam’s Sahebs Who Never Left.
